Name: (CP) Ohmu
Author: StormDrakon
Description:
[b][center][size=4][u]Ohmu[/u][/size][/center][/b]

This mod adds the [url=https://nausicaa.fandom.com/wiki/Ohmu]Ohmu[/url], the guardians of the sea of corruption in the Stuido Ghibli film: Nausicaa of the Valley of the wind. This is one of my favorite movies and i love these weird creatures so i wanted to see them walking around my stardew farm. I figured i would share this mod in case anyone else loves this movie or just wants weird arthropod looking fellas walking around.

They find mushrooms and truffles!

Updated the file for Stardew 1.6. Also added some color variations! Theres now a Blue, Purple, and Albino Ohmu that find slightly different mushrooms.


[u]Installation Guide for Content Patcher for Stardew 1.6:[/u]

[b] ﻿1.[/b] Install SMAPI and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
﻿[b]2.[/b] Run the game at least once to make sure there are no existing problems
﻿[b]3.[/b] Download the Slimedew Rancher file and drag and drop the entire unzipped [CP]
Slimedew Rancher folder from the download into ﻿your Stardew Valley\Mods


[u]Installation Guide for BFAV Ohmu:
[/u] ﻿(For Stardew 1.5 and below)[u]

[/u] ﻿1. Install SMAPI and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3296?tab=files]BFAV[/url] (unofficial update is located [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-68#post-47274]here[/url])﻿
﻿2. Run the game at least once to make sure there are no existing problems
﻿3. Download the BFAV Ohmu zip file and drag and drop the entire unzipped BFAV Ohmu folder from the download into ﻿your Stardew Valley\Mods
﻿4. Upon making a Big Barn a new animal will become available from Marine's Ranch: the Ohmu! 


Thank you for checking out this mod page! This is a practice for me for pixelart. If i have time i might add more to the mod but have no plans to at this time.
